# messq_auth

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq auth

manage bearer tokens for daemon authentication

### Synopsis

Create, list and verify the bearer credentials a messq daemon reads from
its --auth-file. Secrets are generated at cryptographic strength on this
machine, shown exactly once on stdout, and never accepted from argv or
environment variables: a credential that entered shell history is a
credential you must rotate.

```
messq auth [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq auth add --auth-file /etc/messq/tokens --id ci --roles publish,consume --streams 'orders*' # noexec: writes to /etc/messq
  messq auth ls --auth-file /etc/messq/tokens # noexec: names a machine-specific token file
  printf '%s' "$CRED" | messq auth check --auth-file /etc/messq/tokens # noexec: shell pipeline carrying a credential
```
